header: Where maintenance teams gain their hours back
subheadline: Four places the working day leaks time, and what the platform does about each. The tiles are sized by how much the average service company recovers, not by how interesting the feature is.

items.title: The morning board
items.description: Every open call, every technician and every SLA clock on one screen. The board refreshes in a median of 1.8 seconds, so two dispatchers can work it without stepping on each other.

items.title: Seven days without a signal
items.description: Vertex Field caches a week of jobs, asset history and forms on the device. Technicians in plant rooms and basements keep working, and everything syncs when they surface.

items.title: Parts that are actually there
items.description: Van stock is counted at close-out rather than once a quarter, so the number a dispatcher sees is the number in the van.

items.title: Signature to invoice
items.description: The customer signs on the tablet, and the job sheet and parts list land in the accounting export the same evening.
